title.purpose: The name in the title plaque only.

band.purpose: Section names on the crimson option band.

label.purpose: Field labels and short headings inside a window.

body.purpose: Prose and explanations, never pixel type.

shadows.name: pixel-drop-sm
shadows.purpose: Under pixel labels on dark ground, as the game draws text.

shadows.name: pixel-drop
shadows.purpose: Under bone lettering on the band, nav and titles.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Hover brightness and the save note.

motion.name: dur-press
motion.purpose: Steppers and slots responding to a press.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gold plaque for the main action on a section.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 2px 14px; border: 6px solid transparent; border-image: var(--px-plaque-gold) 3 fill / 6px stretch; background: none; color: #2b1907; font-family: 'Pixelify Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,236,170,.55); } .ds-btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn:active { border-image-source: var(--px-plaque-gold-down); padding-top: 4px; padding-bottom: 0; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f7d677; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Oak plaque for secondary actions and unchosen tabs.
components.css: .ds-btn-oak { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 2px 14px; border: 6px solid transparent; border-image: var(--px-plaque-oak) 3 fill / 6px stretch; background: none; color: #f2ead7; font-family: 'Pixelify Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; text-shadow: 0 2px 0 #000; } .ds-btn-oak:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-oak:active { border-image-source: var(--px-plaque-oak-down); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Crimson plaque: removing, and the chosen tab.
components.css: .ds-btn-red { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 2px 14px; border: 6px solid transparent; border-image: var(--px-plaque-crimson) 3 fill / 6px stretch; background: none; color: #f2ead7; font-family: 'Pixelify Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; text-shadow: 0 2px 0 #000; } .ds-btn-red:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-red:active { border-image-source: var(--px-plaque-crimson-down); }

components.name: Value Row
components.description: A black option row for any typed value.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 6px solid transparent; border-image: var(--px-field) 3 / 6px stretch; background: #050608 padding-box; color: #ded7c6; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 15.5px; padding: 3px 6px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; outline: none; } .ds-input:hover { border-image-source: var(--px-slot); } .ds-input:focus { border-image-source: var(--px-field-focus); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a49f93; }

components.name: Option Band
components.description: The crimson band that opens every section, a fleur-de-lis either side of the name.
components.css: .ds-band { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 36px; padding: 4px 44px; font-family: 'Pixelify Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; color: #f2ead7; text-shadow: 0 2px 0 #000; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #07080b 0 2px, #c2463f 2px 4px, #86202a 4px calc(100% - 4px), #45101a calc(100% - 4px) calc(100% - 2px), #07080b calc(100% - 2px)); } .ds-fleur { width: 18px; height: 18px; background: var(--px-fleur) center / 18px 18px no-repeat; }

components.name: Nav Row
components.description: A destination in the rail: item icon and pixel label; crimson plaque in gold brackets when current.
components.css: .ds-nav { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 8px 0 2px; border: 6px solid transparent; color: #f2ead7; font-family: 'Pixelify Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; text-decoration: none; text-shadow: 0 2px 0 #000; } .ds-nav:hover { border-image: var(--px-plaque-oak) 3 fill / 6px stretch; } .ds-nav-on, .ds-nav-on:hover { border-image: var(--px-plaque-crimson) 3 fill / 6px stretch; } .ds-nav-on::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -8px; border: 10px solid transparent; border-image: var(--px-bracket) 5 / 10px stretch; pointer-events: none; } .ds-nav-ico { width: 36px; height: 36px; background: #2b180c; }

narrative.overview:
The Mod Builder is Barony's own Settings and Play windows, redrawn so that building a mod feels like part of the game rather than a website about it. Every editor is a framed window on a speckled slate floor. Each section is opened by the crimson option band from Barony's Settings menu, and every value sits on a black option row. The art is pixel work drawn in scripts/pixel-art.mjs and scaled by whole numbers, 2px to a pixel, so no edge ever blurs. Nothing is taken from the game except the item icons the site already ships for its pickers.

It is a working tool used for an hour at a time, so the world contributes type, palette, density and one signature, the crimson band, and never the layout or the controls.
keyCharacteristics: A crimson option band with a fleur-de-lis either side opens every section.
Gold plaques for the main action, oak plaques for secondary actions and tabs, crimson for removing.
Black option rows for every value, with a 2px slate edge that turns gold on focus.
Barony's gold corner brackets mark the current page and whatever has keyboard focus.
Two voices: pixel type for the menu, Barlow for anything read or typed.
Real Barony item icons (36px, 1:1) beside each destination.

rules.name: The Three Gems Rule
rules.body: State is said with Barony's gems: ruby for an error, sapphire for advice, emerald for done. A state line leads with its gem sprite, never a warning glyph.

rules.name: The Black Row Rule
rules.body: A value the user can read or change sits on a black row. Windows are slate, the floor is darker slate, and only rows are black, so a field always reads as a field.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Pixel type for titles, bands, buttons, the nav and labels; Barlow for values, hints and explanations. A sentence longer than a label is never set in the pixel face.

rules.name: The Drawn Light Rule
rules.body: Light comes from the art, not from CSS: bevels are pixels in the maps, presses swap to the pressed map. No blur shadows, no gradients pretending to be material.

dos: Do open every section with the crimson option band (Panel).
Do put values on black rows and let the edge carry hover, focus and error.
Do draw new ornaments, icons and frames as maps in scripts/pixel-art.mjs, then run it.
Do lead a state line with its gem: ruby, sapphire or emerald.
Do use the gold corner brackets for the chosen item and for keyboard focus.
Do keep sentences in Barlow and keep pixel type to menu chrome.
donts: Don't copy menu art or fonts from the game; the item icons in public/item-icons/ are the only game art the site ships.
Don't round corners or add box shadows; depth and corners are in the pixel maps.
Don't nest a bordered box inside a window to make a sub-section.
Don't use emoji or font glyphs as icons on buttons or row tools.
Don't scale pixel art by anything but whole numbers.
